papers.title: Confidence Before Answering: A Paradigm Shift for Efficient LLM Uncertainty Estimation
papers.relevance: Confidence-before-answering and its joint optimization are existing research directions. Their confidence is probability of producing a correct answer under a policy, unlike our fixed-event P(Y=1). Our requested JSON field order is a diagnostic factor, not an implementation of CoCA or a new training algorithm.

papers.title: ORCE: Order-Aware Alignment of Verbalized Confidence in Large Language Models
papers.relevance: Answer-first conditional confidence and decoupled optimization are prior proposals. Do not infer from this abstract that answer-first is universally better, or interpret our prompt ordering contrast as their training procedure.

papers.title: LLMs are not (consistently) Bayesian: Quantifying internal (in)consistencies of LLMs' probabilistic beliefs
papers.relevance: Belief-update coherence and downstream utility need separate evaluation when the world model is misspecified. Our synthetic generative model is specified exactly, so posterior error is a valid diagnostic here but does not establish natural-task utility. The abstract alone is insufficient to implement their information-processing-gap benchmark.

research_implications: Do not pitch answer/probability ordering alone as the paper's novelty.
Retain the original communication question: whether recipient-specific evidence routing improves utility over strong matched-information baselines.
Before a native literature-baseline comparison, read full methods and source implementations; avoid renaming our generic prompts after published systems.
Record these as context, not new post-hoc primary endpoints or grounds to modify a running experiment.
manuscript_status: sections_v7 still describes language-model measurements as outstanding. A future empirical revision must distinguish older software counts, completed diagnostic batches, unfavorable protocol pilots and unperformed natural-task tests. No manuscript change is made by this note.
